meta.name: content-amplifier
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "amplify influencer content with paid media", "set up whitelisting or Spark Ads", "decide which posts to boost", "repurpose influencer content", "turn one video into multiple ads", or "build a UGC asset library"; produces (paid mode) a content-selection scorecard, a paid amplification strategy (whitelisting/boosting/dark posts), audience targeting, and a budget+optimization plan, or (repurpose mode) a rights-tracked content inventory, a 1-video-to-10+-asset repurposing map, per-format transformation specs, and a 30-day distribution plan. Not for gating whether a deliverable is publishable or FTC-compliant — use creator-content-auditor; not for the always-on brand posting calendar — use social-calendar-builder; not for drafting a net-new idea into platform-native packages — use social-creative-builder. 复用达人内容 / 内容放量.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把达人内容变成付费广告素材并制定投放策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你运营达人营销，需要把一条视频变成多条广告并规划投放。
copy.tagline_en: Turn influencer content into paid ad assets and build a distribution plan.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run influencer marketing and need to turn one video into multiple ads with a paid strategy.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你分析达人内容，选出值得付费推广的帖子，制定投放策略（白名单、品牌助推、暗文），分配预算，并给出优化方案。
howto.when: 当你手头有现成的达人内容，想通过付费投放扩大其曝光时触发，例如询问“哪些内容值得投流”或要求制定投放计划。

say.text: 帮我把这5条达人TikTok按投放价值排序，预算5000美元。
say.note: Claude 会生成内容评分表和预算分配建议。

say.text: 哪些达人内容应该优先投流？
say.note: Claude 会基于内容表现和钩子质量给出推荐。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you analyze influencer content, select posts worth amplifying with paid media, develop a strategy (whitelisting, brand boosting, dark posts), allocate budget, and provide an optimization plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have existing influencer content and want to extend its reach through paid spend, e.g., asking which posts to boost or requesting an amplification plan.

say_en.text: Rank these 5 influencer TikToks by amplification value with a $5,000 budget.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a content scorecard and budget allocation.

say_en.text: Which influencer content should we amplify first?
say_en.note: Claude will recommend based on performance and hook quality.
